title: 1994 Comic Images Brothers Hildebrandt #71 Battle with Red Sea Beast Card
condition_description: Near mint or better. See photos.
description:
1994 Comic Images The Brothers Hildebrandt collector card #71, "Battle with Red Sea Beast" - from the She's Dangerous subset (card 2 of 6). Painted by Greg and Tim Hildebrandt for the 1982 Atlantis calendar and later used as an Epic magazine cover.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
